# Z-Flow - Complete Business Information
# Digitalization Partner Berlin | Process Automation, Custom Software & AI Integration

================================================================================
## COMPANY OVERVIEW
================================================================================

Z-Flow is a digitalization partner based in Berlin, Germany. We help startups, SMEs, and the German Mittelstand digitalize their business processes. Our approach: understand your process first, then build the right solution — whether that's automation, custom software, or AI.

**Founder**: Mahmoud Salard
**Location**: Berlin, Germany
**Markets served**: Germany, Austria, Switzerland (DACH region), International (English-speaking)
**Company type**: Z-Flow UG (haftungsbeschränkt)
**Address**: Menzelstraße 3, 12157 Berlin, Germany
**Experience**: 5+ years process mapping and automation in Germany

**Core approach**:
1. Process Audit — Map your workflows, find bottlenecks
2. Solution Design — Choose the right technology for the problem
3. Build — Agile development with weekly demos
4. Launch & Handover — Full documentation, training, your code

**Core expertise**:
1. Process automation with n8n and Make.com
2. Custom software / MVP development
3. AI integration (OpenAI, Claude, custom LLM solutions)

================================================================================
## SERVICES IN DETAIL
================================================================================

### 1. PROCESS AUTOMATION (n8n & Make.com)

**What we offer**:
Your team is spending hours on tasks a machine could handle in seconds. We map the process, find the bottlenecks, and automate what matters.

**Who it's for**:
- Businesses with repetitive manual processes
- Companies wanting to connect multiple tools/apps
- Teams drowning in data entry and manual reporting
- Organizations seeking GDPR-compliant automation

**Platforms we use**:
- **n8n**: Open-source, can be self-hosted for maximum privacy/GDPR compliance
- **Make.com**: Cloud-based, 1000+ app integrations, visual builder

**Common automation use cases**:
- Lead management and CRM automation
- Invoice processing and financial workflows
- Document workflows and filing
- E-commerce order processing
- Data synchronization between tools
- Reporting and dashboards
- Customer onboarding automation
- Email automation workflows

**What's included**:
- Process audit and bottleneck analysis
- Workflow design and implementation
- API integrations and webhooks
- Error handling and monitoring
- Documentation and training
- 30 days post-launch support

**Timeline**: 1-3 weeks
**Price**: Starting from €3,000

**Keywords**: n8n developer, n8n Entwickler, n8n automation expert, Make.com expert, Make.com Experte, workflow automation services, Prozessautomatisierung, business process automation, GDPR compliant automation, Digitalisierung

---

### 2. MVP / CUSTOM SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT

**What we offer**:
You have a business idea but no product yet. We build your MVP in weeks — functional enough to win users, clean enough to scale.

**Who it's for**:
- Non-technical founders who need a technical partner
- First-time founders validating a startup idea
- Companies launching new digital products
- SMEs needing custom internal tools

**Technology stack**:
- Next.js, React, TypeScript
- Supabase (database, auth, real-time)
- Tailwind CSS
- Vercel deployment

**What's included**:
- Complete web application
- Responsive mobile-first design
- User authentication system
- Database architecture
- API development
- Deployment and hosting setup
- Full documentation
- After-launch support (bug fixes included)

**Timeline**: 4-8 weeks depending on scope
**Price**: Starting from €15,000 (fixed price after process audit)

**Keywords**: MVP development agency, MVP entwickeln lassen, custom software development, Softwareentwicklung Berlin, startup MVP, Digitalisierung Mittelstand

---

### 3. AI FOR BUSINESS / COMPANY BRAIN

**What we offer**:
Your company has years of knowledge trapped in documents, emails, and people's heads. We build AI systems that capture this knowledge and put it to work — internal assistants, smart chatbots, and automation that truly understands your business.

**Technologies we work with**:
- OpenAI API (GPT-4)
- Claude API (Anthropic)
- LangChain
- Vector Databases (Pinecone, pgvector)
- RAG Pipelines
- n8n + AI workflows

**AI use cases we implement**:
- Company knowledge bases from internal documents and data
- Internal AI assistants for employees (email drafting, meeting summaries, report generation)
- Chatbots trained on your company data (SOPs, product docs, customer history)
- Document intelligence (searchable knowledge from contracts, manuals, policies)
- Intelligent automation (context-aware ticket routing, document classification, business rule decisions)
- AI voice agents for customer support

**Our AI principles**:
- Process-first: We understand the workflow before adding AI
- Privacy-first: European or self-hosted solutions when needed
- Explainable AI: You understand what the AI does
- Human-in-the-loop: AI supports but doesn't replace human decision-making

**Keywords**: AI integration services, KI Integration, Company Brain, Firmen-KI, KI Wissensdatenbank, RAG System, OpenAI API integration, AI chatbot development, KI Beratung, Claude API developer, AI for business, KI Implementierung, AI knowledge base, KI Assistent für Mitarbeiter

---

**What we offer**:
Hands-on training tailored to your specific use case. Learn to build and maintain automation and no-code solutions yourself.

**Training topics**:

**What's included**:

## PORTFOLIO / CASE STUDIES
================================================================================

### B2B Sales Prospecting Platform (WeProspectify)
**Category**: Custom Software | **Status**: Built by Z-Flow
**Industry**: Sales & B2B
**Challenge**: Sales teams waste hours on manual prospecting across fragmented tools
**Solution**: Full-stack SaaS with Next.js, Supabase, n8n, OpenAI, Stripe
**Results**: 92% reduction in lead research time, AI-powered personalization, multi-channel outreach

### Airport Passenger Experience App (Layovr)
**Category**: Custom Software | **Status**: Built by Z-Flow
**Industry**: Travel & Hospitality
**Challenge**: Passengers waste layover time with no visibility into airport amenities
**Solution**: Next.js platform with Supabase, AviationStack API, Google Places
**Results**: Real-time data from 500+ airports, personalized recommendations

### AI-Powered Marketing Video Generation
**Category**: AI | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Media & Marketing
**Challenge**: Generate diverse video content from single images at scale
**Solution**: Airtable interface + n8n workflow + OpenAI + Ideogram
**Results**: 50+ videos/week, 90% reduction in production time

### AI Voice Agent for Customer Support
**Category**: AI | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Construction
**Challenge**: Handle project status inquiries 24/7
**Solution**: 11Labs voice AI + n8n + Airtable
**Results**: 85% inquiries handled without humans, 40% satisfaction increase

### End-to-End Lead Generation Pipeline
**Category**: Digitalization | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Sales & B2B
**Challenge**: Unified lead management across platforms
**Solution**: 14 n8n workflows + Airtable + Supabase + Smartlead + Heyreach
**Results**: Single source of truth, 70% faster lead response

### Automated Invoicing System
**Category**: Digitalization | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Finance
**Challenge**: Complex invoicing with create, edit, cancel, reissue
**Solution**: n8n + Airtable with audit trails
**Results**: 95% reduction in errors, one-click operations

### Automated Refund Processing
**Category**: Automation | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: E-Commerce
**Challenge**: Process daily refunds faster without errors
**Solution**: Lexoffice + Airtable + Stripe + Make.com
**Results**: 30 seconds vs 15 minutes, 200+ daily refunds, zero errors

### Car Supplier Data Integration
**Category**: Automation | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Automotive
**Challenge**: Aggregate vehicle data from multiple suppliers
**Solution**: Make.com + PostgreSQL + Airtable
**Results**: 500+ listings synced daily, 3 APIs unified

### Invoice Distribution Automation
**Category**: Automation | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Finance
**Challenge**: Manual invoice routing to different departments
**Solution**: n8n + email + cloud storage integration
**Results**: Zero manual intervention, 100% routing accuracy

### Financial Folder Organization
**Category**: Automation | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Finance
**Challenge**: Manual document filing across categories
**Solution**: n8n + cloud storage + automated categorization
**Results**: Instant organization, eliminated filing errors

### Volunteer Management Platform
**Category**: Custom Software | **Status**: Live
**Industry**: Non-Profit
**Challenge**: Complex onboarding with background checks
**Solution**: WeWeb + Xano with role-based permissions
**Results**: 80% faster onboarding, 50+ team members supported

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
================================================================================

**Q: What makes Z-Flow different from other agencies?**
A: We start with your process, not with technology. With 5+ years of process mapping experience in Germany, we understand your business workflows first, then choose the right solution — automation, custom software, or AI.

**Q: How does pricing work?**
A: After a free process consultation and audit phase, you receive a binding fixed-price quote. No hourly rates, no surprises.

**Q: What's not included in the price?**
A: External costs like hosting, domains, or third-party tool licenses are separate. We advise on cost-effective options.

**Q: Can I continue development myself after the project?**
A: Yes! Everything belongs to you. Full documentation, no vendor lock-in. You can continue development yourself or hire another provider.

**Q: Do you work with clients outside Germany?**
A: Yes, we serve international clients. English communication is standard.

**Q: What's the difference between n8n and Make.com?**
A: n8n can be self-hosted (better for GDPR compliance and data-sensitive workflows). Make.com is cloud-only but has more pre-built integrations.

**Q: How do you decide between automation, software, or AI?**
A: During the process audit, we analyze your workflows and recommend the approach with the best ROI. Sometimes it's a simple automation, sometimes you need custom software, sometimes AI adds real value. We let the process dictate the technology.
